sources.title: Qwen 3.6 Developer Guide: Benchmarks, Architecture & Self-Hosting ...
sources.snippet: Qwen 3.6 developer guide (Updated July 2026): 1M-context Plus, open-weight 35B-A3B, API pricing, and vLLM self-hosting. Note Qwen 3.7 is now the flagship.

sources.title: Qwen3.6-Plus: Towards Real World Agents
sources.snippet: The model now excels at integrating cross-modal information to perform sophisticated analysis and decision-making. Real-World Applicability: Optimized for genuine business scenarios, Qwen3.6-Plus demonstrates superior stability and usability.

sources.title: Qwen 3.6 Complete Guide: 27B Dense, 35B-A3B MoE, and Which to Use
sources.snippet: Qwen 3.6 landed in two open-weight flavors: 27B dense and 35B-A3B MoE. Benchmarks, hardware fit, and which variant to run on your GPU.

sources.title: Gael1125/Qwen3.6-27B-S-1_3-V3 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This repository contains model weights and configuration files for the post-trained model in the Hugging Face Transformers format. These artifacts are compatible with Hugging Face Transformers, vLLM, SGLang, KTransformers, etc. Following the February release of the Qwen3.5 series, we're pleased to share the first open-weight variant of Qwen3.6.

sources.title: Qwen Studio
sources.snippet: Qwen Studio is an official platform from Qwen that empowers both everyday users and developers with unified access to Qwen's series of open-source and proprietary models. It offers comprehensive functionality spanning chatbots, image and video understanding, image generation and editing, document processing, tool utilization, voice and video chat, and artifacts.
